_comment: Pre-registration of the within-approach experiments resumed or completed on 2026-10-29. Written and pushed before any new result of these experiments was computed. Development window only (2019-03..2022-12); the protected window 2023-01..2026-08 stays sealed. None of these enters the primary Holm family of three.

decision.what: Resume the paused Stage 2 conventional-signal experiments (B1..B5, B-All) as within-approach experiments of the Deterministic Quantitative Model, and complete the planned Market Regimes and Committee + JEV experiments.
decision.by: project lead, written instruction of 2026-10-29 ('I do not want them to remain indefinitely marked as Paused or Planned')
decision.resumption_conditions: stage2/methodology/Stage2_Conventional_Signals_PAUSE_2026-10-27.md requires a written versioned decision (this record), a separate pre-registration (this record) and no exposure to historical-window results for these signals (none: the B systems have never been scored in 2023-01..2026-08).

systems.B2: A + 3-month change in the credit spread
systems.B4: A + VRP proxy (VIX^2/12 minus 22-day realized SPY variance)

AP1_financial_signals.definitions: Unchanged: stage2/config/stage2_frozen_config_v2.json (system_B_primary_signals, system_B_runs) and stage2_signal_manifest_v2.csv. Code unchanged: stage2/scoring/stage2_backtest.py and stage2_portfolio.py. Inputs: the pinned snapshot manifest v3 (all free public series; no Bloomberg input is needed).
AP1_financial_signals.run: the canonical development spec stage2/scoring/stage2_run_spec_dev_v4.json, written to a new output folder; it must reproduce the archived development run before anything is reported
AP1_financial_signals.confirmatory: B-All vs A (the predeclared confirmatory conventional system; frozen config selection_rule). Component runs B1..B5 are attribution diagnostics.
AP1_financial_signals.primary_metric: normalized pooled squared-error improvement vs A (frozen evaluation.loss_normalization), paired circular block bootstrap, 6-month blocks, 5000 draws, seed 20261027
AP1_financial_signals.test: two-sided bootstrap p = 2 x min(P(draw <= 0), P(draw >= 0)); significant at 5%. Components: Holm-corrected within the five-component family (frozen evaluation.multiple_testing).
secondary: per-asset OOS R2 and relative MSPE vs A
portfolio level through the same frozen Black-Litterman allocator: net CER and supporting metrics, paired net-CER bootstrap vs A (frozen settings), break-even cost (Stage 2 convention 14)
signal coverage: feature availability by month

robustness.rule: An improvement is called robust only if it is significant overall, has the same sign in both halves, and improves forecasts for at least 2 of the 3 assets.

AP1_financial_signals.not_resumed: The B robustness items stay paused (10Y-2Y curve, IG OAS, alternative VRP); they are not part of this experiment.
AP1_financial_signals.disclosure: Archived development results of these systems exist (2026-10-27) and their headline was noted in the pause record (B-All, B2 and B4 did not beat A). Re-running cannot change them; this record fixes how they are reported. No system is selected or relabelled after the results.

R2_volatility.rule: VIX close on the decision date (CBOE, pinned Stage 2 series) >= 20 is 'stressed', otherwise 'calm'; known at the 20:00 ET decision; threshold fixed here

measures: JEV - Deterministic and Committee - JEV net-CER contrasts within each regime with the frozen paired bootstrap
REG_market_regimes.status: diagnostic only (frozen evaluation.event_regime_analysis): never used to select or tune anything
REG_market_regimes.disclosure: The signal value-added analysis (2026-10-29) reported active returns by a different, trailing-realized-volatility split; this registered VIX rule is not derived from it.

AP2_committee_plus_jev.rule: Each month, the SPY weight is the equal-weight average of the Committee's and JEV's saved target SPY weights; TLT = 1 - SPY. No parameters.
AP2_committee_plus_jev.why_this_rule: Both systems decide on the same 272 month-end dates, for the same SPY/TLT universe and the same 12-month horizon, with information cutoffs (16:00 ET) before the 20:00 ET decision. Their forecasts are in different units (expected returns vs P(stocks beat bonds) and a tilt), so combining portfolios avoids inventing a conversion. The average of two weights inside 40-80% SPY stays inside it.
AP2_committee_plus_jev.evaluation: shared evaluator: same entry/exit closes, 5 bp per dollar traded, DTB4WK cash, start from cash; development months 2019-03..2022-12
comparisons: Committee + JEV vs its own 60/40 SPY/TLT benchmark
AP2_committee_plus_jev.test: net CER difference, paired circular block bootstrap (6-month blocks, 5000 draws, seed 20261027), two-sided p; within-approach, outside the primary family
AP2_committee_plus_jev.disclosure: Both components' development results are already reported (Committee - JEV +0.44 pts, p 0.72); a combination of the two can be anticipated to lie near them. It is reported whatever it shows and is never scored in the protected window before a GO record.
